SELECT 
  CASE WHEN CAST(e.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_count' AS integer) > 0 OR CAST(e.env_metrics->'humidity'->>'excursion_count' AS integer) > 0 THEN 'Non-compliant' ELSE 'Compliant' END as compliance_status,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(e.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_count' AS numeric)), 2) as avg_temp_excursions,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(e.env_metrics->'humidity'->>'excursion_count' AS numeric)), 2) as avg_humidity_excursions
FROM environmentalmonitoring e
GROUP BY compliance_status;

SELECT 
  q.qc_checklist->'customs_and_regulatory'->>'regulatory_compliance_status' as compliance_status,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(e.env_metrics->'temperature'->>'excursion_count' AS numeric)), 2) as avg_temp,
  ROUND(AVG(CAST(e.env_metrics->'humidity'->>'excursion_count' AS numeric)), 2) as avg_humidity
FROM qualitycompliance q
JOIN environmentalmonitoring e ON q.reckeyqc = e.reckeylink
GROUP BY q.qc_checklist->'customs_and_regulatory'->>'regulatory_compliance_status'
ORDER BY avg_temp;
